_comment: Machine-readable patch chronology used by freshness_check.py. Every entry cites the official page it was taken from. `modes` lists the client modes the patch shipped for; `balance_modes` lists the modes whose rules, pools, or numbers actually changed (defaults to `modes`). A source is judged against the latest balance entry for its mode, so a Battlegrounds source can stay CURRENT across a constructed-only patch. Add a new entry the day a patch or hotfix ships.
